hero.regna-town.alligat.biography: Raven sought an excellent commander for his mission for a long time before finally attracting the attention of Elniga, a representative of the Crab race. Although Crabs are known for being difficult to control, Elniga proved his methods were very sound. Under his command, the Crabs are particularly strong and disciplined. All this makes Elniga one of Raven's right-hand commanders in the upcoming continental war.
hero.regna-town.alligat.name: Elniga
hero.regna-town.alligat.specialty.descri: Increases the Attack and Defense of Giant Crabs or Armored Giant Crabs after reaching Level 3.
hero.regna-town.alligat.specialty.name: Giant Crab
hero.regna-town.aquaron.biography: Aquaron, the Sea Bishop, is one of the best heirs in the world of Water Magic. He is the founder of the Sea Bishop Association, which studies the practical application of Water Magic. He spent much time in the water ritual department, earning high prestige among the Sea Bishops. In battles under his command, Hydromancers become a powerful force.
hero.regna-town.aquaron.name: Aquaron
hero.regna-town.aquaron.specialty.descri: Increases the Attack and Defense of Hydromancers or Sea Diviners after reaching Level 6.
hero.regna-town.aquaron.specialty.name: Hydromancer
hero.regna-town.aurora.biography: Aurora was a student in Hydron's library. She completely mastered one of her teacher's magical techniques, allowing her to control ice. After he ascended to the elemental planes, she continued to study and digest his many manuscripts. Perhaps eventually, Aurora's prophecies will make her a worthy successor to Hydron.
hero.regna-town.aurora.name: Aurora
hero.regna-town.aurora.specialty.descrip: Effect of Ice Bolt is greatly increased, depending on the difference between the hero's level and the target's level (the lower the target's level, the better the effect).
hero.regna-town.aurora.specialty.name: Ice Bolt
hero.regna-town.azul.biography: Azul is the master of the Leviathan Ice Magic School. A longtime professor at the school, she teaches the secrets of casting frost spells, a technique she has mastered perfectly. Tired of teaching, she requested to join the continental war launched by Raven, as she always wanted to apply her skills in real combat.
hero.regna-town.azul.name: Azul
hero.regna-town.azul.specialty.descripti: Effect of Frost Ring is greatly increased, depending on the difference between the hero's level and the target's level (the lower the target's level, the better the effect).
hero.regna-town.azul.specialty.name: Frost Ring
hero.regna-town.gallas.biography: Gallas comes from the Elven race. His name was originally Gallius, and he was one of the outstanding military commanders under Gelu, though they did not get along. Once, while carrying a message for the Enroth Elves across the sea, he was caught in a storm. His ship sank, but he was saved by Illyanis, who was returning from a routine patrol and had just defeated pirates. Illyanis allowed him to keep his Elven habit of practicing archery. Over time, this former Elven leader became so enamored with the coastal inhabitants that they became his best friends. The Sirens and Water Spirits who practiced with him called him in their own dialect: Gallas. Under this name, he became one of the main commanders of the continental war.
hero.regna-town.gallas.name: Gallas
hero.regna-town.gallas.specialty.descrip: Receives a 5% extra bonus to Archery skill for every level attained.
hero.regna-town.gallas.specialty.name: Archery
hero.regna-town.illyanis.biography: Illyanis is a descendant of Wild Sirens. Due to her bloodline, she is unaffected by their cries and considers them her best soldiers. Now, Sirens execute her orders faster than the wind. Illyanis's main characteristics are her subtle tactical style and her ruthlessness toward enemies.
hero.regna-town.illyanis.name: Illyanis
hero.regna-town.illyanis.specialty.descr: Increases the Attack and Defense of Sirens or Demon Sirens after reaching Level 4.
hero.regna-town.illyanis.specialty.name: Siren
hero.regna-town.klastrus.biography: Klastrus grew up in the depths of the ocean but was curious about what lay beyond the surface. Despite being mocked by his peers, he constantly tried to approach the shore. Eventually, it almost cost him his life; he was thrown onto the beach by a massive wave and nearly died under the scorching sun. However, he was saved by Undine, the leader of the archer unit under Raven. When she saw Klastrus lying lifeless on the shore, she ordered her subordinates to do everything possible to save the poor octopus. Over time, he began learning defensive martial arts and ship transport methods. This quickly made him a qualified military leader, capable of not only obtaining contributions from coastal pirate enclaves but also leading his troops into battle. Raven did not initially let him join his war, but Illyanis took a chance on him under Undine's protection and never regretted it.
hero.regna-town.klastrus.name: Klastrus
hero.regna-town.klastrus.specialty.name: Armorer
hero.regna-town.klastrus.specialty.toolt: Receives a 5% extra bonus to Armorer skill for every level attained.
hero.regna-town.maridis.biography: As one of Hydron's four students and one of the founders of his library, Maridis reached perfection in the art of restoring mana. His greatest desire is to one day find the magic key to mana restoration. This key was created by Leviathan and named the Pearl of the Ocean. Knowing of its existence from his teacher years ago, he has not given up on finding it. After all, if successful, mana would never run out.
hero.regna-town.maridis.name: Maridis
hero.regna-town.maridis.specialty.descri: Receives a 5% extra bonus to Mysticism skill for every level attained.
hero.regna-town.maridis.specialty.name: Mysticism
hero.regna-town.marin.biography: As the master of Aquaron's Sea Bishop Guild, Marin is an expert in Water Magic. He fully understands all the nuances of this magical school. With Aquaron's assistance, Raven accepted Marin into his continental war and granted him the rank of Admiral.
hero.regna-town.marin.name: Marin
hero.regna-town.marin.specialty.name: Water Magic
hero.regna-town.midia.biography: Midia, a student of the Deep Sea Oracle Hydron, mastered a special aspect of Water Magic - its decay effect. After collecting numerous manuscripts from the Storm Library, she delved deep into the essence of this part of Hydron's teachings and became an unrivaled expert in the field.
hero.regna-town.midia.name: Midia
hero.regna-town.midia.specialty.descript: Effect of Weakness is greatly increased, depending on the difference between the hero's level and the target's level (the lower the target's level, the better the effect).
hero.regna-town.midia.specialty.name: Weakness
hero.regna-town.omegar.biography: Omegar served under Sargas, and after some time, her combat experience and mastery of attack techniques earned his favor. Although the Sea Witches did not initially like the ambitious Siren, they eventually became convinced of her reliability and dedication, recommending her to Raven who was looking for commanders for the continental war.
hero.regna-town.omegar.name: Omegar
hero.regna-town.omegar.specialty.descrip: Receives a 5% extra bonus to Offense skill for every level attained.
hero.regna-town.omegar.specialty.name: Offense
hero.regna-town.raven.biography: Raven is a strong-willed commander and an excellent diplomat. As a native of the Triton race, he advocates for using soldiers of his own kind, who respond readily to him. Raven faces the daunting task of diplomacy with the continent.
hero.regna-town.raven.name: Raven
hero.regna-town.raven.specialty.descript: Increases the Attack and Defense of Tritons or Triton Guards after reaching Level 1.
hero.regna-town.raven.specialty.name: Triton
hero.regna-town.sabrin.biography: One of Hydron's most capable students, Sea Bishop Sabrin mastered one of the main components of storm magic - hurling lightning at enemies. However, he has not yet succeeded in understanding all the wisdom of Hydron's teachings. Thus, he continues to work in the Storm Library, hoping this magical art will fully open its doors to him.
hero.regna-town.sabrin.name: Sabrin
hero.regna-town.sabrin.specialty.descrip: Effect of Lightning Bolt is greatly increased, depending on the difference between the hero's level and the target's level (the lower the target's level, the better the effect).
hero.regna-town.sabrin.specialty.name: Lightning Bolt
hero.regna-town.sargas.biography: Sargas has long studied the basics of navigation and intelligence, achieving considerable success. By skillfully using his knowledge, he successfully controlled a large number of pirate enclaves. Learning of this, Commander-in-Chief Raven invited him to join his war, taking charge of naval operations.
hero.regna-town.sargas.name: Sargas
hero.regna-town.sargas.specialty.descrip: Receives a 5% extra bonus to Navigation skill for every level attained.
hero.regna-town.sargas.specialty.name: Navigation
hero.regna-town.stella.biography: Stella spent a lot of time in the library exploring ancient manuscripts from whirlpool shipwrecks. For this reason, she quickly became a powerful mage. She focused her studies mainly on Haste spells. Hearing of her abilities, Raven granted her the rank of Admiral in his war.
hero.regna-town.stella.name: Stella
hero.regna-town.stella.specialty.descrip: Effect of Haste is greatly increased, depending on the difference between the hero's level and the target's level (the lower the target's level, the better the effect).
hero.regna-town.stella.specialty.name: Haste
hero.regna-town.undine.biography: Shining Undine is one of the best students of the elf Gallas. She not only mastered archery skills but also the wisdom of commanding war. As time passed, her authority among her people became indisputable. Under her command, they always show excellent morale. Her sharp mind and natural cunning made Undine prove herself as an indispensable scout. For a long time, Illyanis did not need to find anyone else for this position in his continental war.
hero.regna-town.undine.name: Undine
hero.regna-town.undine.specialty.descrip: Increases the Attack and Defense of Undine Archers or Neptune Archers after reaching Level 2.
hero.regna-town.undine.specialty.name: Undine Archer
